The independent-run candidate alone has undetermined hand. Confidence medium; predecessor alpha identification remains qualified.

S06, after connexes, contains a zigzag with a right foot and a lower-right looped continuation, crossed by several diagonals. S03 has a short upper arm meeting the body at the left apex, a clear live upper alpha and a clear live lower alpha. Retain A026-S03 exactly; its joined-head state is supported, high confidence.

S04 has a separate short upper run, a live upper alpha, and a dense angular overtrace at the lower-right index position. The lower form is consistent with alpha but its opaque crossing does not settle cancellation versus a heavily retraced live alpha. Keep A026-S04's literal paths and opaque fill, while recording all four complete C026-S04 attachment/state combinations, with the lower alpha qualified in each. The explicit state mapping replaces only the lower alpha token in each of C's four complete readings by unsure-alpha, preserves their order and every role/hand/attachment field, and leaves the upper live alpha firm. Primary: cancelled qualified lower alpha, head/retrace; then live qualified lower alpha with head/retrace; then those two lower states with independent upper run. The independent-run candidate alone has undetermined hand. Confidence medium; predecessor alpha identification remains qualified.

S05 has a separate short upper run, a dark upper-left mass above it, a second dark mass at the lower index position, and a clear live alpha followed by a comma and a small closed oval at the upper right. The two dark masses are retained literally. Preserve all 24 complete C026-S05 state combinations in their recorded order: cancelled/live lower alpha, cancelled upper-alpha/independent upper dark trace, oval 0/circle/o, and head/retrace/independent upper run. In this root set, replace the lower alpha in every state by unsure-alpha, and replace each cancelled upper-alpha candidate by cancelled unsure-alpha; no live upper-right alpha is qualified. This is an explicit token mapping of each C state, with its role, attachment and separately scoped hand fields retained. Use A026-S05's literal paths/fills and its primary 0/circle/o order. The upper dark trace is his hand under the cancelled-alpha reading and undetermined hand under the independent-trace reading. The short upper run has that same separate candidate-specific attribution. These retained alternatives do not add a mathematical operation. Confidence medium overall, low for recovery of the opaque predecessor letters.

L008: the long bowed guide runs under the inserted equation and curls down beside connexes. The raised equation is attached before connexes. Preserve A026-G03's complete placement and guide, with the local S03-S06 qualifications just specified. The visible equation includes et, a setminus before E, and an equals sign before S05. H's omission/replacement of the interlinear material and its connexes doubt are recorded from their own source markers. Placement and the readable words/signs are high confidence.

S06, after connexes, contains a zigzag with a right foot and a lower-right looped continuation, crossed by several diagonals. Preserve A026-S06's literal drawing and both complete cancelled readings, Sigma with lower alpha first and les second. Cancellation is high confidence; the cancelled content remains medium. Original C026-R03 is retained. C026-R02 parts 1, 2 and 3 remain qualified at S04 lower, S05 lower and S05 upper respectively; part 4 awaits S07. C026-R15's S05 oval component is retained without changing its single original parent/part structure.
